Name: mono's Portraits (CP) 1.6
Author: monoSDE
Description:
[size=4][b]mono's Portraits
[/b][/size]
I made this mod for fun and practice - my goal being to recreate all the villager portraits in my own style while trying to remain somewhat faithful to the original designs. I'd love to hear your feedback regarding the changes in looks or in case you think an expression doesn't match the scene!

You can also follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/mono_sde]Twitter[/url]!

To install simply place the extracted [i][CP] mono's Portraits[/i] folder in [i]Stardew Valley/Mods. [/i]Remember to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]!

Vanilla villager portraits for Content Patcher
